title: Signed verdicts and decision provenance
canonical_requirement: Bind every verdict to chain, contract, job, unit, attempt, worker, result, verifier, policy, evidence, nonce and expiry.

scope.unit_model: CMP-1 fixed-price repository scope uses one canonical payable unit per job; unitId equals jobId.
scope.retry_model: attemptRef and monotonic attempt identify the exact latest result-bearing retry attempt.
scope.correctness_boundary: Authentication/provenance does not itself prove correctness or authorize settlement.

invariants: cross-chain/cross-contract replay fails through EIP-712 domain separation
nonce replay and expiry fail closed
canonical worker/attempt context is read from worker evidence rather than relayer fields
frozen verification policy is included in signed provenance
negative verdicts preserve provenance without authorizing custody release
verification remains separate from correctness proof and settlement authority
